articles.summary: Madison, Wis., Oct. 16, 2026—The board of directors of MGE Energy, Inc. (Nasdaq: MGEE), today declared the regular quarterly dividend of $0.5083 per share on the outstanding shares of the company's common stock, payable December 15, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business December 1, 2026.
articles.title: MGE Energy Declares Regular Dividend

articles.summary: Madison Gas and Electric Company (MGE) today announced a financing partnership with six regional and locally owned banks operating throughout MGE's service territory.
